validation_truth_surface: Validation truth only; not runtime truth, signal truth, evidence truth, public proof, or public-safe approval.

alert_shape.positive_match_shape: PowerShell or pwsh process identity plus encoded-command or base64 decode command-line behavior.
alert_shape.negative_control_shape: Rejects encoded-looking command text when PowerShell process identity or command-line evidence is absent.

partial_or_missing_fields.image_missing_originalfilename_present: Allowed only when OriginalFileName supplies PowerShell or pwsh identity.

case_packet_references.role: Controlled-test case packet and human-review boundary.

case_packet_references.name: autosoc triage packet
case_packet_references.role: Deterministic support packet derived from the controlled validation result.

proof_references.name: validation result
proof_references.supports: Controlled positive and negative fixture pass/fail result.

proof_references.name: pipeline proof route
proof_references.supports: Public proof-loop routing metadata and blocked-claim categories.

proof_references.name: proof record route
proof_references.supports: Cross-repo proof record route only; does not raise this receipt above CONTROLLED_TEST_VALIDATED.

next_promotion_gate: Human review plus separately approved runtime/signal/evidence capture and proof/publication promotion before any runtime-active, signal-observed, evidence-linked, public-safe, production, customer, or SOCaaS availability claim.
